lcc_original: 上帝說：『天穹要有發光之體來分晝夜；它們要做天象，定節令、日子、年歲；
notes: LCC 天穹 (vault of heaven) absorbs both H07549 (raqia/firmament) and H08064 (shamayim/heavens) since LCC combines the two Hebrew nouns into a single compound
UNV implicit {<WAH01961>}{<WTH8804>} (והיו, 'and they shall be') becomes explicit in LCC as 它們要做 — braces dropped per Rule 3, tags attached after 做 (the verb corresponding to היה)
LCC 天象 (celestial signs) maps to H0226 (oth/sign); UNV uses 記號 — different Chinese word but same semantic referent
